 Order

The petitioners are before this Court calling in question proceedings in C.C.No.716/2023, pending before the XXXVII Additional CMM, Bengaluru, registered for the offence under Section 498A of the IPC.
Petitioners are the husband and mother in-law of respondent No.2 - complainant.
Learned counsel for the petitioners and respondent No.2 in unison submit that the parties to the lis have settled their dispute among themselves.
The parties to the lis were before the family Court in M.C.No.1072/2022 and have decided to obtain a decree of divorce by mutual consent in the said proceedings.
The parties have parted their ways and filed a joint affidavit of the parties, by drawing up certain terms and conditions.
One of the conditions of the settlement also recognizes the closure of the present proceedings.

4. We state that, the Petitioner No.1 has issued a Bankers Cheque of Rs.23,00,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Three Lakhs Only) towards the Respondent No.2 as a permanent alimony/ maintenance vide Bankers Cheque No.752319 dated 22.05.2024 drawn on State Bank of India V.V. Puram Branch, Bengaluru and the same was handed over to the Respondent No.2 before the Ld. Family Court on 27.05.2024 and the same was accepted by the NC: 2024:KHC:19382 Respondent No.2 along with the exchange of articles before the Ld. Family Court and the marriage of the Petitioner No.1 and Respondent No.2 was dissolved and the terms of the settlement agreement between the parties was accepted by the Ld. Family Court.

5. We state that, as per Clause No.8 of the settlement agreement the Respondent No.2 gave an undertaking to co-operate with the Petitioner No.1 for quashing/ closure of Crl Petition No.8024/2023 i.e. the present Petition wherein the Petitioners have sought to quash all further Proceedings against the Petitioner No.1/ Husband and Petitioner No.2/ Mother-in-law in CC No:
716/2023 for offences punishable under Section 498(A) of I.P.C. pending on the file of XXXVII ADDL. CHIEF METROPOLITAN MAGISTRATE, AT BENGALURU (37th ACMM).

6. We mutually state that, to quash all further proceedings against the Petitioner No.1/ Husband and Petitioner No.2/ Mother-in-law in CC No: 716/2023 for offences punishable under Section 498(A)
of I.P.C. pending on the file of XXXVII ADDL, CHIEF METROPOLITAN MAGISTRATE, AT BENGALURU (37th ACMM) insofar as the Petitioner No.1/ Husband and Petitioner No.2/
Mother-in-law are concerned.

7. We mutually agree that we have no claims left whatsoever either from the past, present or future against each other with respect to the proceedings in CC No:
716/2023 and withdraw all the allegations made against the petitioners herein.

8. We state that, we both have settled all our disputes as on date and the Respondent No.2/ Wife has decided to withdraw the entire case against the Petitioner No.1/ Husband and Petitioner No.2/
Mother-in-law herein.

9. We state that, we agree that we shall close all pending cases in relation to this case and mutually agree that we shall not take any legal action against each other in connection with the instant case anytime in future and undertake not to initiate any further actions against each other in this regard.

Though the offences alleged against the petitioners in the case at hand inter alia is one punishable under Section 498A of the IPC, since it is a marital dispute and now, they have arrived at settlement and parted their ways, I deem it appropriate to accept the joint affidavit of the parties and terminate the proceedings against the petitioners, as the allegations are not against the State.

4. For the aforesaid reasons, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The criminal petition is disposed.
(ii) The proceedings in C.C.No.716/2023, pending before the XXXVII Additional CMM, Bengaluru, stands quashed.
